anomalies.observed: C13, the capacitor drawn across U8 (AP63203WU) BST (pin 6) and SW (pin 5), is labeled 100pF.
anomalies.expected: The bootstrap capacitor of the AP63203WU buck is ~0.1 uF (100 nF) in the device's typical application; 100 pF is three orders of magnitude too small to hold the high-side gate-drive charge across a 1.1 MHz switching cycle.

evidence.quote: C13 100pF (power.kicad_sch, at U8 SW/BST bootstrap node)
U8 SW(5) drives the buck inductor L1 (3.9 uH) and bootstrap cap C13

anomalies.impact: The BST-SW bootstrap rail would droop severely each cycle so the buck's high-side MOSFET may not fully enhance; the +3V3 rail could fail to start or regulate, taking down the MCU, MAX31855 channels and status LED.

parsed.summary: Most reviewed connectivity (power mux TPS2121 IN1/IN2/ILIM/SS, AP63203 FB-to-3V3, heater switch U6 IN/DIAG_EN/CL/FAULT, three MAX31855 SPI/CS channels, USB-C CC dividers and 5.1k pulldowns) matches the specification, but the buck converter's bootstrap capacitor C13 is drawn as 100 pF instead of the ~0.1 uF required by the AP63203WU, which would prevent the 3.3 V rail from starting/regulating.
